name: disk-cleanup
description: 通用磁盘回收：默认只报告不删（confirm 必须是 yes 才动手）。清理已退出容器、悬空镜像、构建缓存（保留 cache_keep），并断言关键容器仍在跑、磁盘水位达标。

steps.description: 闸门：报告当前占用；确认后才继续
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
echo '== 当前占用 =='
docker system df
if [ "${confirm}" != 'yes' ]; then
  echo '需要确认：传 confirm=yes 才会真正清理（本次只做了报告，未删除任何东西）' >&2
  exit 2
fi
echo cleanup-confirm-ok

steps.description: 清理：已退出容器 → 悬空镜像 → 构建缓存（保留 ${cache_keep}）
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
echo '== 已退出容器 =='
docker container prune -f
echo '== 悬空镜像 =='
docker image prune -f
echo "== 构建缓存（保留 ${cache_keep}）=="
docker builder prune -f --keep-storage "${cache_keep}" || echo 'builder-prune-skip（此 docker 不支持 --keep-storage，已跳过而不是清空）'
echo cleanup-done

steps.description: 清理后：磁盘水位 ≤ ${disk_max}%；容器仍在跑（可选）
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
USE=$(df -P / | awk 'NR==2{gsub(/%/,"",$5); print $5}')
echo "disk-use=/$USE%"
[ "$USE" -le ${disk_max} ] || { echo "disk-still-high /=$USE%（阈值 ${disk_max}%）" >&2; exit 3; }
if [ -n "${container_name}" ]; then
  docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "${container_name}" 2>/dev/null || { echo "container-missing ${container_name}" >&2; exit 4; }
  echo "container-still-ok ${container_name}"
fi
echo cleanup-verified

steps.description: 留档：清理后的占用明细
steps.script:
set -u
docker system df
df -h / | tail -n 1
